title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Return Inspection and Return Fees
content:
Every item returned to Ridgeline Tool Rental is inspected on its return date, and the inspection record decides the return fees. The inspection records the condition found (clean with no damage, needing cleaning, damaged, missing an accessory, or a confirmed malfunction), the cause of any damage, the repair cost assessed and the number of accessories not returned.

## Damage assessment (in force)

Damage is assessed at the class's shop labor rate per hour plus parts, and it is billed under the damage protection terms.

*Hypothetical:* 2 hours on a Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape tiller at the class shop labor rate of 75.00, plus 30.00 of parts, is assessed at 180.00.

## Former clauses

> Former clause on cleaning and accessories: equipment returned needing cleaning beyond normal use incurred the class cleaning fee, and each accessory not returned incurred the class charge per accessory. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the missing-accessory charge.

> Former clause on fuel: fuel below the level at checkout was charged the class price per missing eighth plus the class refuelling service fee once. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the refuelling charge.

> Former clause on engine hours: on metered equipment, engine hours used above the class's included hours per billed day multiplied by the billed days were charged at the class's overtime percentage of the daily rate per hour. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the engine overtime charge.

The class figures these former clauses named (cleaning fee, price per eighth, included engine hours and the others) are unchanged on the class tables.

## Points of judgement

- *Is a returned unit ever left uninspected?* No; every returned item is inspected on its return date.
- *Where does a repair cost come from?* From the inspection record, assessed at the class shop labor rate plus parts.

superseded_clauses: Equipment returned needing cleaning beyond normal use incurs cleaning_fee_usd, and each accessory not returned incurs accessory_missing_fee_usd.
Fuel below fuel_level_out is charged fuel_charge_per_eighth_usd per missing eighth plus fuel_service_fee_usd once.

On metered equipment (engine_hours_per_day above 0), engine hours used (hour_meter_in minus hour_meter_out) above engine_hours_per_day times the billed days are charged at overtime_rate_pct_of_daily_per_hour percent of the daily rate per hour, as fee_type overtime_hours.
